rationale: The core statistical approach is exactly right for the design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with time correctly kept categorical over four discrete points, an explicit t0 reference, and a stated power caveat for 3 interaction degrees of freedom with n=3 per cell; per-timepoint contrasts and trajectory clustering appropriately localize the pattern and are correctly labelled descriptive. QC is concrete (metadata reconciliation, library sizes, count distributions, PCA-based outlier flagging) though it stops at flagging without a stated action policy and does not mention colouring by batch; the low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, tied to smallest group size) is minimal and justified. Normalization is only implicit — raw counts go into DESeqDataSetFromMatrix and VST/rlog is used for clustering, but size-factor estimation is never stated, so the criterion is only inferred. BH at alpha 0.05 is explicit, but apeglm/ashr appear only in a package list with no described shrinkage of the reported effects; enrichment names collections and uses the tested gene set as the universe with a useful shared-trend contrast set, yet leaves the ORA-vs-GSEA choice, the ranking metric, gene-set size window, and MSigDB version unspecified. Reporting covers method, design, thresholds, gene counts and design caveats but omits software versions.
